experience.title: Technical Product Owner
highlights: Owned the vision and roadmap for Jetstar's Internal Developer Platform (IDP) and Unified Infrastructure, cutting infrastructure onboarding time by ~40% and driving adoption across 10+ engineering squads, eliminating ticket-driven dependencies on the platform team.
Drove voluntary adoption of the Platform Team Engagement Guide across 10+ squads with no mandate, standardizing onboarding and automation-first workflows through enablement, not enforcement.

Introduced a dual-track operating model separating platform support and roadmap delivery, improving operational reliability and execution for an 8-member platform team supporting 10+ engineering squads.

Owned end-to-end migration of 10+ workloads from Jetstar to Qantas Cloud Platform, defining migration sequencing, risk mitigation strategy, and landing zone alignment, with zero production incidents at cutover.
Maintained 100% PCI DSS compliance across existing infrastructure through year-on-year assessment cycles, coordinating audit readiness, evidence gathering, and continuous control improvements.

Owned platform delivery across 4 geographies (SG, AU, BKK, MNL), aligning 6 stakeholder functions including security, cloud, and release management to unblock engineering squads and sustain adoption velocity.
Defined and tracked platform OKRs, SLOs, and delivery metrics, reporting to senior leadership to drive data-informed prioritization and roadmap trade-off decisions.

experience.title: Cloud Engineer
highlights: Optimised AWS workloads across unified infrastructure, reducing infrastructure costs by ~20-30% through right-sizing and improved resource utilisation.
Transformed CI/CD pipelines from GoCD to GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time from hours to minutes and standardising reusable automation frameworks across 10+ teams.
Architected and managed Akamai CDN solutions including WAF rules and Bot Manager policies, strengthening application security posture and improving global edge performance.
Implemented observability solutions using Datadog, Splunk, and CloudWatch, improving monitoring, incident detection, and operational visibility.

Spearheaded emergency cloud hardening initiative following CrowdStrike findings, remediating 100% of critical and high vulnerabilities across AWS infrastructure within 3 weeks, restoring security posture ahead of schedule.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
highlights: Engineered Jetstar's microservices-based modular distribution platform from the ground up, supporting 100k+ daily e-commerce booking requests with high availability and API-driven architecture.

Built and maintained scalable mobile backend services and DevOps pipelines (C#, REST/SOAP, Jenkins, AWS CloudFormation), increasing release frequency and reducing deployment failures through standardized CI/CD practices.
Partnered with operations to implement proactive monitoring and alerting, significantly reducing unplanned downtime and enhancing overall service reliability.

experience.title: Application Developer
highlights: Delivered enterprise applications across airline and e-commerce domains using .NET and Java, implemented CI/CD pipelines, and established frontend design standards via Atomic Design adopted as a team baseline for thoughtworks.com website.
